rule: Tall hair under headwear: Afro, Einstein Shock, Bun, and Long Straight clip under any headwear except Headphones and Laurel Wreath. Each of these four hair traits ships with a second hat-fit PNG the compositor swaps in automatically when headwear is present (4 extra asset files, not extra traits). Nothing is re-rolled.
Goggles vs. brimmed hats: Safety Goggles and Welding Goggles cannot pair with Wide-Brim Field Hat or Green Eyeshade; the straps and brims collide.
Cybernetic redundancy: the Cybernetic Chassis base cannot receive Cybernetic Eye or Circuit Tattoo (already machine).
Casts stay analog: Bronze Cast and Marble Cast bases cannot receive Cybernetic Eye, Circuit Tattoo, or Static Glitch.
One crown only: Laurel Wreath excludes the Pencil Behind Ear accessory, which occupies the same ear anchor (Gold-Tassel Mortarboard is same-layer, impossible by construction).
Redacted stays severe: the Redacted background cannot pair with Grinning or Eureka expressions; tonal mismatch.
